instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Implement a pipelined module that implements a 4-bit counter with a synchronous load input. 
The module should have three inputs (clk, reset, and load) and one output (count). The counter should count up on each rising edge of the clock input, 
unless the reset input is high, in which case it should reset to 0. If the load input is high, the counter should load its value from a 4-bit input (L) 
on the next rising edge of the clock input. The module should also have an asynchronous reset input that sets the count to 0 regardless of the input values. 
Use pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
